An opportunity to make a difference
At Border to Coast our purpose is to make a difference to the LGPS and we’re looking for an Enterprise Risk Management Analyst to join our award-winning team on a permanent basis.
As a customer-owned and customer-focused organisation, integrity is one of our values, as is our collaborative and sustainable approach. Our focus is to secure the pensions of over two million people who provide valuable services to their communities and society. We’re the UK’S largest pension asset owner and we provide innovative investments that deliver sustainable returns over the long term.
As an Enterprise Risk Management Analyst you will play a key role in strengthening risk oversight across Border to Coast Pensions Partnership. You'll support the development and delivery of our Enterprise Risk Management framework through insightful risk reporting, data analysis, systems administration, incident management oversight, and quality assurance activities. You'll help identify emerging risks and trends, assess control effectiveness, and provide meaningful insights that support informed decision-making across the business.
The role – what you’ll be doing
Risk Reporting & MI
• Assist in the development and maintenance of dashboards and reports using Excel, Power BI and PowerPoint to provide risk, control and incident insights to business functions, Executive Committee and Board audiences.
• Produce accurate and timely management information for governance committees, highlighting trends, emerging risks and remedial actions.
Risk Systems Administration
• Act as the technical owner and subject matter expert for the Risk Management System, ensuring optimal functionality and data quality.
• Support with implementation, testing and deployment of risk system enhancements and supplier-driven developments.

Want to use your software development skills to make a real difference in a manufacturing environment?
